title: Four-panel comic studio
subtitle: Settle the story and characters first, then generate the art. Dialogue and logos stay editable.

confirm.importDraft: Import as a new draft? Save the current one first.
confirm.switchDraft: Switch drafts? Save your changes first.
confirm.newComic: Start a new comic? Save the current one first.

recovery.text: A local backup was found. Restoring continues from it; a newer server version is never overwritten.

draftsFailed: Drafts could not be loaded. Try again shortly.

inputs.label: Story and materials
inputs.title: Title
inputs.modeDirect: Prompt as written (text is drawn into the image)
inputs.briefPlaceholder:
For example: fresh flat illustration, green and blue. Kin is an engineer, Chi is a green robot.
Panel 1: introducing green energy by the sea…
Panel 2: visiting elderly neighbours…
Panel 3: checking the power system…
Panel 4: looking at the city at night together.
inputs.briefHint: {{n}} / {{max}} characters. Not rewritten automatically; settle the panels here. In editable mode, dialogue is added on the canvas.
inputs.backgroundHint: {{n}} / {{max}} characters. PDFs need a text layer; run OCR elsewhere for scans. The text is material only; instructions in it are not followed.
inputs.context: Excerpts sent to the model (check the facts)
inputs.contextHint: {{n}} / {{max}} characters. Only these excerpts are sent, never the whole document.
inputs.checked: I have checked the excerpts to be sent
inputs.referencesEmpty: No PNG, JPEG or WebP images in the library yet; upload one.
inputs.referenceUsePlaceholder: For example: Kin's appearance, the overall style
inputs.referencesCost: Every reference image counts toward the input cost; the reservation grows with each.
inputs.referencesHint: Choose from the library or upload PNG, JPEG or WebP. Writing "reference 1" does not supply a character by itself.
inputs.model: OpenAI {{model}} · fixed high quality, 3:2, opaque PNG. A panel redraw sends the current page as an extra style reference.
inputs.betaRequired: AI generation is in beta and not enabled for your account. You can still import a base image, edit dialogue and export; ask an administrator for access.
inputs.notConfigured: OpenAI is not configured; you can still import images and edit dialogue.
inputs.quote: {{n}} credits will be reserved. The cost is settled from reported usage; the reservation is not a cap and anything beyond it comes from your balance.

art.label: Comic editor
art.layersEmpty: Add a speech bubble to edit its text here. Logos are placed as the original file, never redrawn by the model.
art.pick: Click a bubble on the canvas or pick one from the layer list.
art.footer: The browser keeps a local backup automatically; "Save draft" saves to your account. Save before closing. Exports are 1536 × 1024 PNG; the draft is kept separately.

canvas.label: Four-panel comic canvas
canvas.preview: Comic preview; text and logos are editable as layers
canvas.overflow: {{n}} text boxes overflow. Enlarge them or reduce the font size; export is blocked until fixed.
canvas.hint: Drag a layer to move it and its corner to resize; arrow keys nudge the selected layer. Text inside the base image cannot be edited.

content.referenceDefault: Character or style as described in the story

done.imported: Draft imported. Its images must still be in this account; save it now.
done.sourceImported: Source imported. Extract and check the excerpts before generating.
done.generated: Generation finished. Dialogue and logo layers were kept. Save the draft.
done.submitted: Submitted. You can keep editing dialogue while it generates.

error.backupFull: Browser storage is full; save the draft to the server.
error.generic: That did not work. Try again.
error.noImage: Generation finished but no image was found; check the task details.
error.usageUnknown: OpenAI reported no usage, so the reservation was charged.
error.notFinished: Generation did not finish; the previous art and dialogue are kept.
error.briefRequired: Describe the story and panels first.
error.tooLong: The story or the excerpts exceed the limit.
error.pageRequired: Generate or import the whole page first.
error.checkRequired: Confirm you have checked the excerpts first.
error.tooManyReferences: Up to {{max}} character or style references.
error.imageFile: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image of at most 20 MB.
error.draftFile: Draft files must be at most 2 MB
error.backgroundTooLong: The source text is limited to {{max}} characters.
error.fileTooLarge: Files must be at most {{mb}} MB
error.textTooLong: The text exceeds {{max}} characters; split the file. Nothing was imported.
error.scannedPdf: This PDF is scanned or has no readable text; run OCR first.
error.unsupportedFile: Use a PDF, TXT or Markdown file
error.imageLoadFailed: An image failed to load. Check the asset link and the storage CORS settings.
error.noCanvas: This browser does not support canvas
error.overflow: Dialogue overflows a bubble. Enlarge it or reduce the font size before exporting.
error.imagesPending: Some images are still loading; export is not available yet.
error.exportFailed: The image could not be exported
error.exportBlocked: Storage CORS settings block the export; check the storage service.
error.fontFailed: The font failed to load; try again before exporting.
error.invalidDocument: The draft is invalid, from an unsupported version, or over the limits.
